title: CSV cleaning with a rejection report
prompt: Build a CLI that reads a CSV from stdin and prints a cleaned report. CSV rules: UTF-8 text; records end with LF or CRLF; fields may be double-quoted, in which case they may contain commas, line breaks and doubled quotes ("" means one quote); a double quote inside an unquoted field is an ordinary character; a closing quote must be followed by a comma, a line ending or the end of input, otherwise the input is not valid CSV; a leading byte order mark is ignored; completely empty lines are skipped; an unterminated quoted field makes the input invalid. The header record must be exactly id,name,amount, otherwise (and for empty input or invalid CSV) exit nonzero, leave stdout empty and write a diagnostic to stderr. Each later record is processed in order: a record without exactly 3 fields is rejected as malformed; otherwise all fields are trimmed of surrounding whitespace and the record is rejected as invalid when id is not one or more ASCII digits, name is empty, or amount is neither empty nor digits with an optional fractional part of 1 or 2 digits; otherwise a record whose id (compared as an exact string) was already accepted is rejected as duplicate and the first accepted record wins. Print exactly one JSON object and a newline: {rows,summary} where rows lists the accepted records in input order as {id,name,amount} with amount a string or null when empty, and summary is {accepted,rejected:{malformed,invalid,duplicate}} with integer counts. A header-only input is valid and gives no rows. Exit 0 on success. No external services are needed.
